working_title: The Tied Arm That Proved Your Blood Circulates
title: The Tied Arm

chapter_card.treatment: soft cross-fade after the last word + 0.6 s breath; music continues

open_stamp.treatment: Didot italic side label in the edit

set_language: Warm candlelit 17th-century world: dark oak, cream linen, brass, leather books, London fog. Body cutaways are clean, glowing illustrations (warm red arteries, cool blue veins), never anatomical gore. Say 'same 1616 London lecture room' or 'same Harvey study' for continuity; never 'same DNA'.
forbidden: HARD REJECT: Orbit robot; photoreal; Ken Burns or still push; gore, wounds, blood on skin, cut flesh or real animal organs (animal hearts only as Harvey's ink drawings); live or dead animals on a table; lava drip / molten bead; underside lamp bulb or shade cup; unfinished flat cards; garbled writing; unfinished Explorer hair; DNA helix; readable text or logos baked into the plate (labels and the De Motu Cordis title are added in the edit); twin Explorer; faces in the first two seconds of the film. Never say 'same DNA' or 'lab DNA' in a Veo prompt.
always_fails: garbled card text or wrong sums (2 oz, 1/8, 1000 checked by hand)
unfinished Explorer hair or melted face
gore: wound, blood on skin, cut flesh, real animal organs
a face in the first two seconds of the film
motion_lock: Real Veo camera and object motion on every plate. No freeze-pad, no loop, no Ken Burns.
quality_note: Flow Veo 3.1 on the Mac Mini CDP worker, benoats@googlemail.com only. Quality for anything with light (candles, glowing loop, stove heart) and every hero plate; Fast only for low-risk garnish. One plate at a time until the first KEEP; after 2 same-framing FAILs change the framing.
labels: White Didot italic side label, 1-4 words, one at a time, on the plate's first beat; added in the edit.

plates.vo_land: Harvey showed his experiments at the College for more than nine years before he printed a word.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same 1616 London lecture room: William Harvey, a short man of about forty, olive skin, black hair to the collar, small pointed black beard and moustache, dark keen eyes, black physician's gown with a plain white falling collar, demonstrates to rows of gowned physicians; candles burn down and are replaced as the seasons pass at the window. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: The most famous one needs nothing but a strip of linen.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same lecture room: Harvey holds up a plain strip of cream linen to the benches. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: He ties a band round a man's upper arm and pulls it tight.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. A man's bare arm rests on the oak table, arm and hand only, no face. Harvey's hands tie the linen band round the upper arm and pull it tight. Clean skin, nothing gory. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Below the band, the hand goes pale and cold.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same arm: below the band the hand slowly turns pale and cool; above the band a soft pulse throbs under the skin. Arm only, clean skin. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Why?
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Clean glowing cutaway of the same arm: the tight band squeezes every vessel shut and the warm red stream stops dead at the band. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Then he loosens it, just a little.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same arm: Harvey's fingers loosen the linen band just a little. Arm only. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: (+1.3 s into) Now the arteries, which run deep inside the arm, can push blood under the band.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Clean glowing cutaway: deep arteries inside the arm push warm red under the loosened band towards the hand. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: But the veins near the skin are still squeezed shut.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same cutaway: the blue veins near the skin stay pinched shut under the band, and blood piles up below it. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: The hand flushes red, and the veins below the band swell up like ropes.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. The real arm again: the hand flushes pink and the veins below the band swell into soft blue cords like ropes. Clean skin. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: So blood comes in through the arteries and leaves through the veins.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Clean glowing cutaway of the arm: red flows in deep down, blue flows back out near the skin, a simple loop. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Now the little doors.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Close on the swollen blue vein on the forearm: small knots stand out along it. Clean skin. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Each one is a valve, the flaps Fabricius found.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. The camera pushes into one knot and the skin becomes a clean cutaway: a pair of Fabricius's little doors inside the vein. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Harvey presses a finger on a vein and pushes the blood towards the hand.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Close on the forearm: a fingertip presses the vein and pushes the blood towards the hand. Clean skin. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: It stops dead at the next valve.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same vein: the pushed blood stops dead at the next knot, which bulges; cutaway glimpse of the little doors shut tight. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: He pushes it the other way, towards the heart, and it slides through easily.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same vein: the fingertip strokes the other way, towards the heart, and the blood slides through easily; the little doors swing open. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: He empties a short stretch of vein between two fingers.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Two fingertips press a short stretch of the vein and slide apart, emptying it. Clean skin. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: It stays empty until he lifts the finger nearer the hand.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same stretch stays flat and empty; then the finger nearer the hand lifts. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Then it fills straight back up, from below.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same stretch refills from below, from the hand side, in one smooth wave. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Every door in every vein opens one way: towards the heart.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Clean glowing cutaway: a long vein with many pairs of little doors, all opening the same way towards the heart as the blood flows home. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Fabricius thought they slowed the blood.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Fabricius's old drawing beside Harvey's new one: in Harvey's, the little doors turn like lock gates steering a glowing stream home to the heart. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: You can see a little of this yourself.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. The back of a relaxed hand and inside of a wrist, no face, veins faintly blue under clean skin, soft daylight. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: The blood inside them is on its way back to your heart.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same hand: a soft warm glow moves along the veins from the hand up the wrist towards the arm, on its way home. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: In sixteen twenty-eight, Harvey published it all in a small Latin book, printed in Frankfurt: On the Motion of the Heart and Blood.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. A wooden printing press by candlelight in Frankfurt: a small sheet comes off the press and is folded into a small book. The title page is left plain (title added in the edit). Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: (+5.0 s into) In sixteen twenty-eight, Harvey published it all in a small Latin book, printed in Frankfurt: On the Motion of the Heart and Blood.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Hands turn the pages of the small book: woodcut-style plates of a forearm with a band tied round it and the veins marked. No readable text. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Not everyone was impressed.

plates.vo_land: (+4.2 s into) John Aubrey, who knew him, later wrote that after the book came out, Harvey "fell mightily in his practice", and many people thought he was crack-brained.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. John Aubrey, a man in a long brown wig, writes in a notebook by candlelight; through the window, Harvey's door with patients walking away. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: And one gap was still open.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. William Harvey, a short man of about forty, olive skin, black hair to the collar, small pointed black beard and moustache, dark keen eyes, black physician's gown with a plain white falling collar, at a window at dusk looks at a drawing of the blood's loop with one part left blank.
